speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin my assessment, can you please describe how many skin lesions you have and tell me how long they have been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum Contagiosum

I suspect this is not chickenpox, as your description of painless, non-itchy papules fits molluscum better than the vesicular rash of varicella. To confirm, I would like to see images of the lesions; can you provide a clear photo of the affected area on the abdomen?
